column2: Retain year 172, Demetrius’s forces and journey to Media for help against Tryphon. The recruitment purpose is explicit, not a completed conquest of Media.
Retain Arsaces as king of Persia/Media and the command to seize Demetrius alive. The qualifier alive is essential to the following captivity account.
Retain the commander’s attack/capture/presentation and Arsaces placing the prisoner under guard. The named English subject resolves the final source pronoun contextually.
Retain quiet during Simon’s days, good sought for his nation and approval of his authority/glory. Four display lines preserve the encomium’s clauses and repeated temporal span.
Retain Joppa as harbour and entrance to sea islands, in two display lines. Among all his glorious deeds is an interpretive rendering of with all his glory, not an explicit source noun for deeds.
column3: Does the opening describe accompanying glory rather than an item among achievements? The inherited wording remains provisional pending a fuller literary revision.

column2: Retain enlarged national borders and control of the country. Two lines preserve the paired claims without adding particular annexed territories.

Propose many captives for many who had been captive, preserving the captivity noun without suggesting an explicitly completed release. Keep the three conquered sites, removal of uncleannesses and absence of opposition in four display lines.
column3: Does gathering captivity mean taking captives or gathering previously displaced people here? The proposed noun leaves that action-history unresolved.

column2: Retain peaceful cultivation, earth’s produce and field-trees’ fruit in the inherited three lines. No crop type or harvest quantity is inserted.
Retain elders in squares, all discussing good things and young men clothed in glory/war garments. Three lines distinguish the social images without converting splendour into a specific armour item.

Retain city provisions, defensive equipment and the fame of glory reaching earth’s end. Three lines preserve preparation and ensuing renown; the territorial expression is not a verified world itinerary.
Retain peace made on the land and Israel’s great gladness in the inherited two-line display. The repeated joy expression remains.
Retain each under his own vine/fig tree and no one frightening them, with inherited two lines. The individual possessives and collective security remain.
Retain cessation of those fighting and kings crushed in those days. Two display lines preserve both claims; the passive does not name an additional agent.
Retain all lowly strengthened, law sought and every lawless/wicked person removed. Three display lines preserve the three actions and their distinct objects.
Retain glorifying holy places and multiplying their vessels, in two lines. The repeated holy-place expression is not shortened to an ambiguous pronoun.
Retain news reaching Rome and Sparta and great grief over Jonathan’s death. The unexpressed hearers are contextual, not a separately named embassy.
Retain Simon’s high-priest succession and country/city control as the heard report. The dependent sentence continues into the written response.
Retain bronze tablets and renewed friendship/alliance previously established with Judas/Jonathan. Both brothers and prior relationships remain.
Retain public reading before Jerusalem’s assembly. Letters naturally supplies the object from the preceding writing without naming a new document.
Retain Spartan rulers/city as senders and Simon, elders, priests and remaining Jewish people as brothers/recipients. Great priest preserves this greeting’s wording.
Retain the envoys’ report of glory/honour and joy at arrival. The paired honour terms are not merged into military success alone.
Retain the formal record and names/patronymics Numenius–Antiochus and Antipater–Jason. The quoted resolution remains inside the Spartan letter.
Retain honourable reception, designated public books and memorial purpose, followed by a copy to Simon. Public records is contextual for the designated books, not a new archive name.
Retain Numenius’s Roman mission and a large gold shield weighing one thousand minas. The source weight is preserved without modern conversion or plausibility correction.
Retain the people’s question about returning thanks to Simon and sons. Sons must not be reduced to Simon alone.

Retain family steadfastness, fighting off enemies, freedom for Israel and bronze/pillar memorial on Zion. Israel supplies the contextual beneficiary of the source’s pronoun, while verbal number shifts are naturally coordinated.
Retain Elul eighteen, year 172, third year of Simon and Asaramel. The opaque term is not silently translated as an office or identified as a known locality.
column3: Is Asaramel a place, title or transmitted phrase of another kind? Its interpretation remains open, and the capitalized inherited form is provisional.

column2: Retain priests, people, national rulers and elders in the great assembly. A declaration was made unfolds the active made known with an unexpressed subject without naming a declarant.
column3: Who made the matter known, and should a closer draft preserve the active construction? The present passive is interpretive.

column2: Retain Simon’s Mattathias/Joarib ancestry, brothers’ self-risk, resistance and preservation of holy places/law. Great glory honoured preserves the cognate emphasis.
Retain Jonathan assembling the nation, priesthood and being gathered to his people. The death idiom is not flattened into a new explicit burial location.
Retain enemy invasion intent and hands stretched against holy places. The bodily threat remains alongside its cultic object.
Retain Simon’s resistance, much of his own money, weapons and troop pay. Private expenditure is explicit and distinct from the separate equipment/pay benefits.
Retain Judean cities, border Beth-zur, earlier enemy weapons and Jewish garrison. The source’s weapons are not silently replaced with a different historical presence claim.
Retain coastal Joppa, Gazara by Azotus’s borders, former enemies, Jewish settlement and provisions for restoration. The exact referent of their restoration remains contextual.
Retain perceived faithfulness, intended glory, appointment and repeated righteousness/faithfulness grounds. The repeated rationale is not shortened to a bare election notice.

Retain prosperity in his hands, removal of nations and citadel occupiers, surrounding defilement and a great blow upon purity. These difficult expressions remain expressly provisional rather than accepted literary polish.
column3: How should the impersonal prosperity construction and blow upon purity be expressed naturally without losing agency or cultic scope? Full syntactic and lexical review remains pending.

column2: Retain Jewish settlement, security for country/city and raised Jerusalem walls. The pronoun it resumes the occupied fortified site without identifying every boundary.
Retain Demetrius confirming the high priesthood accordingly. The inscription’s rationale is not independent verification of every earlier diplomatic detail.
Retain royal friendship and honour with great glory. The title remains distinct from priesthood and command.
Retain Roman address as friends, allies and brothers, and honourable reception of Simon’s envoys. All three diplomatic designations remain.
Retain for ever until a faithful prophet arises. Do not remove either the enduring appointment or the explicit until qualification to impose a simpler constitutional reading.
column3: How do perpetuity and prophetic review qualify one another? The wording remains intact without resolving later institutional implications.

column2: Retain generalship and care for holy places, with appointments over works, country, weapons and forts. Through his authority is contextual for through him and remains provisional.
Retain repeated care of holy places, universal obedience, documents in his name and purple/gold. The repeated responsibility is not deleted as duplication of verse 42.
Retain restrictions on annulling, contradicting, assembling without him and wearing purple/golden clasp. The full prohibition list remains within the decree’s voice.
Retain liability for contrary action or annulment. Liable does not name a death penalty or fine absent from the source.
Retain all people agreeing that Simon act under these terms. The collective assent is reported without inventing a voting procedure.
Retain acceptance as high priest, general and ethnarch over Jews/priests, presiding over all. Ethnarch remains a technical provisional title rather than being equated with king.
Retain bronze inscription displayed conspicuously within the holy enclosure. Its public placement is distinct from the stored copies following.
Retain copies in the treasury for Simon and sons. The family access/provision remains without adding a later inheritance rule.
